0022600219.text: The Toronto Raptors host the Boston Celtics in the Raptors' 11th game of the 2026-27 season, with Toronto at 5-5 (2-2 at home) and sitting 6th in the East and 4th in the Atlantic, 3.5 games back, after a loss in its most recent game. Boston comes in at 8-2, 2nd in the East and 0.5 games behind in the Atlantic, on a three-game winning streak and 5-0 at home, while Toronto is missing Kawhi Leonard, Nate Bittle and Scottie Barnes, who are out, and Collin Murray-Boyles, Immanuel Quickley and Trayce Jackson-Davis, who are day-to-day with game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Toronto lost all four meetings with Boston in 2025-26, most recently 115-101 in Boston on April 5, 2026.
